categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the design, research, development and sales of edge-side AI SoC chips. The main business segments include: (1) Smart Security (68.81% of revenue) - covering consumer, civil and professional surveillance applications; (2) Smart IoT (20.58% of revenue) - including smart home, smart office, smart industry, smart robotics and smart displays; (3) Smart Vehicle (10.61% of revenue) - including ADAS, visual perception and DVR systems. The company also has a 3D sensing business line using ToF technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a Fabless business model, focusing on chip design and R&D while outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging and testing. Core self-developed technologies include: (1) Six major IP modules - ISP (Image Signal Processing), AI processors, audio IP, video codec, display IP and 3D sensing IP; (2) AI-ISP technology for enhanced low-light imaging; (3) Scalable AI processor architecture supporting 0.2T to 32T computing power; (4) Video codec supporting H.264/H.265/AV1 at 4K@120fps; (5) Low-power architecture design with dynamic power management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves multiple customer types across different markets: (1) Smart Security - leading surveillance brands in consumer, civil and professional segments; (2) Smart IoT - global leading companies in smart home, video conferencing, robotics and displays; (3) Smart Vehicle - automotive vision suppliers and Tier-1 manufacturers. The top 5 customers account for 82.90% of sales, with the largest customer representing 37.49% of revenue. Geographic markets include both domestic China and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across multiple regions with offices in Xiamen (headquarters), Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hangzhou and Chengdu in mainland China, plus a Taiwan branch. The company has significant international presence with 2024 revenue from overseas markets at 22.47% of total. Major markets include China mainland (77.53% of revenue) and other countries/regions (22.47%). The company maintains global distribution through both direct sales and distributor networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless chip design company. It is positioned between upstream IP/EDA tool providers and downstream wafer manufacturers, packaging/testing service providers. The company outsources all manufacturing to foundries (primarily TSMC and Samsung), packaging and testing to specialized service providers, while maintaining control over design, R&D, sales and quality assurance functions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) Advancing AI processor technology with support for Transformer architecture and large language models; (2) Developing AI-ISP technology for enhanced low-light imaging and complex lighting scenarios; (3) Expanding into new application domains including smart robotics, smart glasses and 3D sensing; (4) Pursuing international market expansion and localization; (5) Investing in next-generation technologies including 8K video processing and dToF laser radar chips. R&D investment reached 602.35 million yuan in 2024, representing 25.59% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of semiconductor chips using a combined direct sales and distribution model. Direct sales account for 9.56% of revenue while distribution channels represent 90.44%. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of the chips, typically upon delivery to the customer or carrier. The company also generates minor revenue from technical services and equipment leasing. Payment terms are typically full prepayment or payment within 30 days of delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In Smart Security chips, main competitors include Fullhan Microelectronics, Beijing Jingzhun, Huawei HiSilicon and Techwell. In Smart IoT, competitors include Rockchip and Allwinner. In Smart Vehicle, competitors include Mobileye, Ambarella and Horizon Robotics. The company positions itself as a leading provider with comprehensive product lines across multiple segments, strong R&D capabilities, and competitive pricing. The company emphasizes technological leadership in AI-ISP and low-power design.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized semiconductor design company with 2024 revenue of 2.354 billion yuan, representing 16.49% growth from 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 256.26 million yuan, up 25.18% year-over-year. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in March 2024, raising 627.9 million yuan in net proceeds. Total assets reached 4.299 billion yuan at year-end 2024, up 24.98% from 2023. The company maintains healthy profitability with a 35.79% gross margin.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key value propositions include: (1) Advanced AI-ISP technology enabling superior low-light imaging and complex scene processing; (2) Scalable AI processor architecture efficiently supporting diverse application scenarios from low-power devices to high-performance systems; (3) Comprehensive product portfolio across smart security, IoT and vehicle domains providing one-stop solutions; (4) Strong R&D capabilities with 581 research personnel and continuous technology innovation; (5) Competitive pricing and excellent customer service with long-term partnership focus; (6) Proven track record with leading global brands and strong market presence in both domestic and international markets.
